verdict.rationale: Apify documents anti-blocking measures: smart rotation of datacenter and residential IPs, plus a SessionPool that rotates proxies along with cookies. It also supports Playwright, Puppeteer and Selenium, so a developer could script logins and form fills. None of this shows an agent automatically solving CAPTCHAs or getting past login or form walls without manual setup. Missing for 10: documented CAPTCHA solving, automated login and credential handling for agents, automatic form-wall bypass, and independent or hands-on corroboration of getting past walls.
